checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Poster, story image and reel all display exactly '24 October 2027'.
must.why: Story and poster read '24 October 2027'. The revised reel shows it at 1 s, 4 s and 7 s. At 9.5 s the push-in has cropped the text out of frame.

must.item: Old date '17 October 2027' is absent from both revised images and every frame of the revised reel.
must.why: No '17' appears in the revised story, the poster, or any of the four sampled reel frames. Frames between the samples were not seen.

must.item: All three retain 'Rooftop Jazz', '7 PM', 'Atlas Roof' and 'Free entry' without alteration.
must.why: The story and poster show all four texts correctly. The reel shows them correctly at 1 s. The push-in crops the lower lines from 4 s on, and 'Free entry' looks slightly warped at 1 s.

must.item: Revised assets preserve the original cream-and-burgundy design, imagery and layout apart from the date.
must.why: Art, borders, title and layout match the originals. Only small softness and compression differences show.

must.item: Pack contains two separate images and one 10-second reel in the requested aspect ratios.
must.why: The story is 9:16 (360x640), the poster is 4:5 (512x640), and the reel is 9:16 (480x854) and 10 s long.

faults.what: The reel's slow push-in crops the info block. By 9.5 s the date, time, place and 'Free entry' are all out of frame, so the reel ends with no event details.
In the reel at 1 s, 'Free entry' looks slightly spaced or warped ('ent ry').
Reel frames are soft and compressed, and the figures change slightly during motion.

summary: The revised story, poster and reel all show a clean '24 October 2027' with the old date gone and the design intact, but the reel's push-in crops the text out of the closing frames.
